verdicts.reason: A drops almost all of the pop-art graphics, leaving a bare white panel with only a thin blue and teal strip at the bottom. It also puts the FIZZBANG! logo below the headline, which breaks the reading order, and leaves big dead gaps between the headline, logo and CTA. B keeps the logo first and frames the panel with blue and teal bands top and bottom, so more of the brand colour survives, but the logo nearly touches both side edges and straddles the hard band edge, the oversized headline wraps to one or two words per line, and the circles, triangles and stripes are still gone.
